review.assessment: This change appends the remaining rows to `out` when the total count isn't an exact multiple of `PAGE_SIZE`, fixing the previous logic that silently discarded the incomplete last page. No defects were found; the patch correctly restores all missing rows without touching restricted files, constants, or line shapes. All host measurements passed and the audit should now see every row.
